ဒြဗျ（ပု၊န）
[dabba+ṇya．dru+ya．（dravya-saṃ）]
[ဒဗ္ဗ+ဏျ။ ဒြု+ယ။ （ဒြဝျ-သံ）]
DOP: 3 dabba drabya n., mfn. and m. [ S. dravya], 1. ( n. ) ( i ) a substance, an object ; Abh 913 (~aṃ …guṇādhāre); Sadd 760, 28 (samaṇasaṅkhātassa ~assa); — ( ii ) possessions; wealth ; Abh 485 (dhanaṃ tu so ~aṃ vittaṃ); 913 (~aṃ …vitte ca); Ja VI 576, 29* (nikkiṇissāmi ~ena, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee daṇḍena, prob. wr ; 577, 5´ : dhanaṃ datvā mocessāmi); — 2. ( mfn. and m. ) wise; fit, capable; a wise or skilled person ; Abh 229; 913 (~aṃ bhabbe …budhadārusu); Vin III 162, 34 (na kho Dabba ~ā evaṃ nibbeṭhenti; Sp 581, 13 : na kho Dabba ~ā paṇḍitā yathā tvaṃ parappaccayena nibbeṭhesi evaṃ nibbeṭhenti; Sp-ṭ [ Be ] II 345, 22 : dabba ~ā ti dutiyo °-saddo paṇḍitādhivacano ti); S I 187, 5* (~o cirarattasamāhito akuhako nipako apihālu; Spk I 270, 19 : ~o ti °-jātiko paṇḍito) = Th 1218; Th 5 (yo duddamiyo damena danto ~o … apetabheravo hi Dabbo so parinibbuto ṭhitatto; Th-a I 45, 19 : ~o ti drabyo, bhabbo ti attho … puna dabbo ti nāmakittanaṃ, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce ~o ti ~o); Th-a I 46, 9 (°-ttā); II 260, 10 (seṭṭhaṃ sabbakālaṃ uttamaṃ ~aṃ ca); — °- jātika , mfn. , being by nature wise or skilled ; M I 114, 12 (bhikkhu ~o; Ps II 78, 30 : ~o ti paṇḍitasabhāvo); Vism 196, 23 ; Ps I 64, 7 (~o eva hi koci bhikkhu chattaṃ kātuṃ jānāti koci cīvarādīnaṃ aññataraṃ); — °- vācaka , mfn. and m. , expressive of a thing or person; a substantive ; Sadd 300, 24 (~ānaṃ); 747, 18 (~-ttaṃ icchanti); — neg. Sadd 300, 23 (adabbavācakatte); — °- vinimaya , m. , exchange of goods and money ; Dhātup 507 (kī ~e); Sadd 495, 10 (~o kayavikkayavasena bhaṇḍassa parivattanaṃ); — adabba , mfn. , not fit or capable ; Pp-a 215, 7 (bhagavatā dabbajatikā ariyā va gahitā puthujjanā pana ~-tāya na gahitā ti); — see also sarīradavya ( sv sarīra ).
